explanation: When no external force acts on a system, its total momentum p = sum of m*v is conserved, so m1*u1 + m2*u2 (before) equals m1*v1 + m2*v2 (after). This follows from Newton's third law: the equal-and-opposite internal forces deliver equal-and-opposite impulses that cancel. The velocity of the center of mass, v_cm = p_total/(m1+m2), is unchanged by the collision and is a useful invariant on the AP exam. The animation shows two carts approaching, colliding, and separating; the running readout confirms p_total stays fixed and shows v_cm.
bullets: With no external force, total p = m1*v1 + m2*v2 is conserved.
Internal forces are equal and opposite (Newton's 3rd law), so impulses cancel.
Signs matter: rightward is +, leftward is - (note u2 is negative here).
v_cm = p_total/(m1+m2) is unchanged before and after.
